function_revised: Fe-S cluster assembly protein of the IscA/SufA/HesB (A-type Fe-S carrier, ATC) family: a scaffold/carrier delivering [2Fe-2S]/[4Fe-4S] clusters to apo-proteins. RefSeq/Mycobrowser leave it DUF779/hypothetical. RefSeq leaves this locus uncharacterised.

evidence: HHpred (significant): top 8 hits converge on the IscA/SufA/HesB A-type Fe-S carrier fold at Prob 98.1-99.1%, E 3.4e-10 to 4.3e-5 (2P2E/2QGO Fe-S biosynthesis, 2K4Z DsrR IscA/SufA/HesB-like, 1X0G IscA [2Fe-2S], 1S98 yfhF, 2D2A SufA). Lower ParE/RelE TA hits are background (<78%, E>4). NOTE: og=COG3564 is an Uncharacterized-COG (DUF779) yet HHpred resolved it -> counterexample to the COG-unchar=blind heuristic.

HHpred web (MPI Bioinformatics Toolkit, profile-profile remote homology), interpreted in project 'Still unknown gene function', 2026-06-10. A fold/family-level assignment, not a demonstrated function.

literature.summary: No publication in PubMed mentions this gene in its title or abstract — not under its H37Rv locus tag, nor under any of its ortholog identifiers (M. bovis, M. marinum, M. smegmatis, M. leprae, M. abscessus). The atlas annotation rests on sequence/structure evidence, not on a primary study of this gene.
literature.caveat: A verified absence of literature is itself information: it flags an annotation with no primary study behind it.
